import csv, re, subprocess, json, unicodedata
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
p='/mnt/data/pass21_noncard_unproven_candidates.tsv'
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open(p,encoding='utf-8-sig'),delimiter='\t'))
# exclude cardMagia and doppel families for now; exclude pass22 triples and pass23 cardskill triples
skip22={
('itemList.json','457','parameter'),('itemList.json','504','name'),('itemList.json','581','name'),('itemList.json','581','parameter'),('sectionList.json','1289','title'),
*[('sectionList.json',str(i),'title') for i in range(1315,1325)],
('shopItemList.json','527','name'),('shopItemList.json','570','name'),('shopItemList.json','652','name'),('shopItemList.json','654','name'),('shopItemList.json','664','name'),('shopItemList.json','671','name'),('shopItemList.json','978','name')}
skip23={('cardSkillMap.json',k,'name') for k in ['40413','40414','40415','40465','40533','40534','40535']}
# ICU transform helper batch via subprocess uconv not per row; use predefined Japanese bridge + OpenCC? use uconv process all strings with separators
bridge=str.maketrans({'黒':'黑','浜':'滨','織':'织','鶴':'鹤','竜':'龙','愛':'爱','機':'机','覚':'觉','結':'结','願':'愿','燦':'灿','並':'并','満':'满','錦':'锦','倉':'仓','國':'国','學':'学','園':'园','澤':'泽','﨑':'崎'})
# call uconv one at a time is okay ~300

def simp(s):
    s=s.translate(bridge)
    r=subprocess.run(['uconv','-x','Traditional-Simplified'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
    return r
script=[]
for r in rows:
 t=(r['file'],r['key'],r['field'])
 if r['file'] in {'cardMagiaMap.json','doppelList.json','doppelCardMagiaMap.json'} or t in skip22 or t in skip23: continue
 if simp(r['baseline'])==r['current']:
  script.append(r)
print('script-only safe non-doppel',len(script),Counter(r['file'] for r in script))
for fn in sorted(set(r['file'] for r in script)):
 print('\n##',fn)
 for r in [x for x in script if x['file']==fn][:30]: print(r['key'],r['field'],repr(r['baseline']),'->',repr(r['current']))

pass24 又剥离了 **86 项**严格等价 residual，运行时仍是 0 字节变化；范围包括 47 个 item、15 个 shopItem、11 个 section、7 个 pieceSkill 等。数值/罗马等级签名全部保持，残余已降到 **9,027**。

这一步也把“只是简繁/日文字形或机制记法差异”和“真正需要权威翻译判断”的内容进一步分开了。接下来我会直接审 `charaList` 与剩余角色名称/简介，因为这里已经看到 `Magius之翼→玛吉斯之翼`、`万年樱之谣→万年樱的传闻` 这类可能比 baseline 更差的实质改写。

import json,csv
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/mnt/data/magireco_pass25_working/magica/js/libs')
base=Path('/mnt/data/magireco_pass14_work/baseline/magica/js/libs')
offall=json.loads(Path('/mnt/data/magireco_pass14_work/official/authority/authority.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
# remaining candidate triples after p22-25
src=list(csv.DictReader(open('/mnt/data/pass21_noncard_unproven_candidates.tsv',encoding='utf-8-sig'),delimiter='\t'))
used=set()
for p in [
'/mnt/data/magireco_pass22_working/magica/i18n_audit/wiki_authority_pass22_simplified_orthography_cleanup/pass22_orthography_corrections_22.tsv',
'/mnt/data/magireco_pass23_working/magica/i18n_audit/wiki_authority_pass23_typed_wiki_connect_names/pass23_connect_name_authority_7.tsv',
'/mnt/data/magireco_pass24_working/magica/i18n_audit/wiki_authority_pass24_strict_orthographic_mechanical_equivalence/pass24_strict_equivalence_86.tsv',
'/mnt/data/magireco_pass25_working/magica/i18n_audit/wiki_authority_pass25_extended_jp_glyph_equivalence/pass25_extended_glyph_equivalence_52.tsv']:
 for r in csv.DictReader(open(p,encoding='utf-8-sig'),delimiter='\t'):used.add((r['file'],r['key'],r['field']))
rem=[r for r in src if (r['file'],r['key'],r['field']) not in used and r['file'] not in {'cardMagiaMap.json','doppelList.json','doppelCardMagiaMap.json'}]
pks={'charaList.json':'id','formationSheetList.json':'id','shopItemList.json':'id','chapterList.json':'chapterId','itemList.json':'itemCode','sectionList.json':'sectionId'}
for fn in sorted(set(r['file'] for r in rem)):
 print('\n###',fn)
 cur=json.loads((root/fn).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')); off=offall.get(fn,{})
 for r in [x for x in rem if x['file']==fn]:
  if isinstance(cur,list):
   rec=cur[int(r['key'])]
   pk=pks.get(fn)
   ident=str(rec.get(pk)) if pk else None
   auth=off.get(ident) if isinstance(off,dict) and ident is not None else None
  else:
   rec=cur[r['key']]; ident=r['key']; auth=off.get(ident) if isinstance(off,dict) else None
  av=auth.get(r['field']) if isinstance(auth,dict) else None
  match='CURRENT' if av==r['current'] else 'BASELINE' if av==r['baseline'] else '-'
  print(r['key'], 'biz',ident,r['field'],'match',match,'O=',repr(av),'B=',repr(r['baseline']),'C=',repr(r['current']))
